findings.summary: Mamut's Lynwood Investments CY Ltd (Cyprus-registered) was the actual entity that filed the copyright infringement claim against nginx in December 2019, not Rambler directly. Rambler Internet Holding ceded rights to bring IP claims to Lynwood. This means Mamut acted through his personal Cyprus investment vehicle, not through the Rambler corporate structure, suggesting personal initiative rather than purely corporate action. Mamut became part-owner of Rambler with Potanin in 2013, bought out Potanin's stake in 2016. Sberbank acquired 46.5% of Rambler in Aug 2019, leaving Mamut's A&NN with 46.5%. The nginx raid occurred in Dec 2019, six months after F5 Networks bought NGINX Inc for $670M in March 2019.

Mamut confirmed sanctioned: Canada (CA-SEMA) and Ukraine (UA-SA1644). OpenSanctions topics: role.rca (Russian close associate), sanction, poi (person of interest), role.oligarch. Education: Moscow State University Faculty of Law. Not on OFAC SDN list but named in 2018 CAATSA report on Russian oligarchs.
